duckdb_scoring_sql: WITH base AS (SELECT s.source_id, s.tier, s.baseline_confidence, h.health_score, COALESCE(d.drop_order, 99) AS drop_order, s.last_seen, s.expected_cadence_minutes, CASE WHEN date_diff(...) <= cadence THEN 'fresh' ... END AS freshness_bucket FROM source_registry s LEFT JOIN source_health h USING (source_id) LEFT JOIN degradation_plan d USING (source_id)) SELECT source_id, tier, health_score, ROUND(baseline_confidence * (health_score / 100.0), 4) AS confidence_adjusted_edge, drop_order, freshness_bucket FROM base ORDER BY freshness_bucket, edge DESC, drop_order ASC;
freshness_watchdog_design: Every 60 seconds: load coordination.yaml for expected_cadence_minutes, query DuckDB for last_seen/parse_fail_rate/health_score, compute age_minutes, classify fresh/stale/drift/quarantine, track stale_cycles, auto-quarantine at >10 cycles
quarantine_logic: Quarantine after 10 consecutive stale cycles or immediate if age >4x cadence AND high parse_fail_rate. Keep in archival mode, stop routing, require one clean cycle + probation before re-enable.
surprising_detection: Best failure detector is cadence drift + quality decay together, not absolute staleness alone.
round_3_prompt: Design state JSON schema + Python updater for source_health, stale_cycles, quarantine, enabled/disabled, DuckDB view for Synapse
